text:
Maya Patel: Weekly health check for Bluehaven — quick deep dive on p95/p99 by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: streaming p99 for /chat/generate (redwood-3b-v1-stream) jumped ~2.1s yesterday evening. Non-streaming routes ok.

metrics-bot: Summary snapshot (24h window):
```
Route                      | Model                  | Streaming | p95   | p99   | errors
/chat/generate             | redwood-3b-v1-stream    | yes       | 520ms | 2.3s  | 0.6%
/chat/generate             | redwood-3b-v1           | no        | 480ms | 620ms | 0.2%
/embeddings/text-lookup    | redwood-embed-1         | no        | 38ms  | 60ms  | 0.0%
/streaming/session-append  | redwood-3b-v1-stream    | yes       | 210ms | 1.8s  | 0.4%
```
Note: p99 for streaming /chat/generate peaked at 3.1s during the spike window (20:12-20:40 UTC).

Liam Chen: Is there any deploy or config change around 20:00 UTC?

Alex Kim: No deploys to prod. I saw a change to the Dedicated pooling config pushed by infra-team at 19:55 — reduced batching window from 50ms -> 10ms to favor latency for other tenants.

Riley Gomez: That could cause throughput degradation for long-running streaming sessions (more context flushing). Suggest revert to 20ms and monitor.

Maya Patel: Action items:
- @Alex Kim rollback batching window to 20ms on Bluehaven dedicated pool (priority).
- @Liam Chen schedule 30m enablement call with Bluehaven devs to explain streaming best practices and recommend session chunking.
- @Riley Gomez prepare a small eval prompt set to run post-fix to validate p95/p99 regressions.

Alex Kim: Starting rollback now. Command used:
```
# rollback batching window
redwoodctl pools update --pool bluehaven-dedicated --batching-window 20ms
```
Starting at 1779991302, will post results.

metrics-bot: Follow-up (10m after rollback): streaming /chat/generate p99 back down to ~1.1s, p95 ~430ms. Errors unchanged. Spike subsided.

cs-bot: Spend note — Bluehaven MTD spend up 37% vs last month. Correlated with longer streaming sessions and higher token output. Suggested next steps: share token footprint report, propose a cost-optimization checklist (batching, caching, quantization recs).

Maya Patel: Good recovery. Risks: renewal risk low but watch spend — schedule cost review next week. Riley, can you own the eval run and post results in this thread by EOD?

Riley Gomez: On it. Will run eval against master and stream-optimized variants; will include diff of p95/p99 and sample traces.

Liam Chen: I'll block 30m with Bluehaven for Thurs 10:00am PT; agenda: explain streaming tradeoffs, recommended settings, and quick wins to reduce spend.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Closing for now — will reopen if p99 climbs again. :white_check_mark:
